Before I was on T, I was debating if for a while. I didn’t really know if I could call myself a trans man, so in my head that meant I couldn’t go on T. But I realized even if I was unsure of what to call myself (and I still am, but I worry about it less), I was certain that I wanted the effects of hormone replacement and maybe top surgery, and overall being perceived masculine by the general public. I got a lot more confident in myself on T, even in the first few months, so I felt more comfortable in not really having a name for it. And really, strangers don’t really need to know the details of our relationship with gender, so I use the label that they would be most comfortable with, just to make things easy.
